tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background, sidebar and bars: a cool near-white, a cool charcoal in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Second paper: panels (sub-groups, stats, an open note), filled fields, code, logs, floating panels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections and around the bars. Separators only (1.2:1 on `paper`): never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Edges of controls: fields, checkboxes, selects. 3.5:1 or more on `paper` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the numbers that matter. 17.5:1 on `paper` (light), 15:1 (dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, facts, axes, icons at rest. 5.6:1 or more on `paper` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent, ink blue: links, focus, selection, running, the text of buttons, checked boxes. 6.5:1 / 7.5:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Pass, confirmed, finished. Always with an icon and a word. 4.9:1 / 7.6:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Fail, refuted, failed runs, errors in place. 5.2:1 / 6.3:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Inconclusive, killed, stale. Always with an icon and a word. 5.5:1 / 8:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Run 1 of 6 (blue), drawn solid. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Run 2 of 6 (orange), drawn dashed. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Run 3 of 6 (dark green), drawn dotted. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Run 4 of 6 (violet), drawn dash-dot. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Run 5 of 6 (magenta), drawn short dashes. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Run 6 of 6 (teal), drawn long dashes. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

groups.name: Serif
groups.note: Only text a person or an agent wrote.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Warmup shortens the time to a stable loss.
styles.usage: A proposal statement, the largest serif on the page: italic means proposed.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: All 9 runs with warmup ≥ 300 stay under a grad-norm of 10.
styles.usage: What people and agents write: note titles and bodies, memory, rationale, findings, text blocks.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: A caption written for a table or figure; its number ("Fig. 1.") is interface, in the sans.

groups.name: Sans
groups.note: The interface: everything Beamtime itself names, labels, counts or states.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Titles of blocks, dialogs and panels; group and run names as titles.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Labels, table headers, status words, crumbs, meta.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: An accent of the interface, never for running text.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Section labels, ids, code, logs, keys.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to word, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside rows and controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related items; cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between blocks.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, panels, hover rows, floating panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, check pills, chips, slider tracks.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Unused by the app since Section labels moved above the content; kept because custom blocks may use it.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Space above and below a Section's content.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of prose.

tokens.name: measure-short
tokens.usage: Longest line of a statement.

dash.note: Line styles for runs, as SVG stroke-dasharray: run n is drawn in data-n with dash-n, so curves stay apart in grayscale and for color-blind readers.

tokens.name: dash-1
tokens.usage: Run 1: solid.

tokens.name: dash-2
tokens.usage: Run 2: dashed.

tokens.name: dash-3
tokens.usage: Run 3: dotted.

tokens.name: dash-4
tokens.usage: Run 4: dash-dot.

tokens.name: dash-5
tokens.usage: Run 5: short dashes.

tokens.name: dash-6
tokens.usage: Run 6: long dashes.

tokens.name: stroke-data
tokens.usage: Curve width in charts.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the edges of controls.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke, with square caps and mitred joins.

fonts: TeX Live 2025: fonts/opentype/ibm/plex (IBM Plex Sans 3.004, Mono 2.3)
